About this item

  • Capri Blue Petite Jar Candles - The instantly recognizable silhouette and bright white color of our glass jar candles makes them versatile enough for any home decor. Light and bright, these white candles are perfect for any space, any time of the year. All in all, a class act. This Capri Blue Volcano candle has a burn time of up to 40 hours.
  • Volcano Scented Candles - With its familiar feel and cult-like following, Capri Blue Volcano is the perfect blend of tropical fruits and sugared citrus. Like the excitement and energy of a summer night rendezvous, this fragrance is simply unforgettable.
  • Luxury Candles - Our soy wax blend has been fine tuned to give the ultimate fragrance experience. Our high-quality ingredients help to provide long lasting candles as well as provide a more fragrant experience.
  • Candle Care - Always allow the top of the candle wax to liquefy fully before blowing it out to help avoid tunneling. Keep the wick trimmed to ¼” & trim wick before the 1st burn. (Caution: Don’t drop debris into the wax. While burning, never place your decorative candles on uneven or sensitive surfaces or leave unattended.) Discontinue use when ½” wax remains to prevent damages to surfaces. Repurpose these glass candle jars in fun and exciting new ways!
  • About Us - Inspired by contemporary fashion trends, Capri Blue creates exciting new products for every season. Our Capri Blue blended soy wax candles are available in several beautifully colored candle jars. From small candles to large candles, these beauties are available in black, blue, white, aqua, and more - Buy them all! You can’t go wrong.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Volcano Capri Blue A Love Story
The obvious? It’s a candle. It smells good. These guys are asking for a review…and I couldn’t just give the thing five stars and move on. Nope…I’m REQUIRED to write an essay?! Of course they want more than a simple stars rating situation. Here it goes… When I first received the candle…my heart almost beat out of my chest with pure elation. I held back the tears of joy as I tore open the Amazon box. As I ripped into the box…I stopped. I had to take a moment to emotionally prepare myself for the greatness of the NEW Volcano candle. I had wept for days after burning the last bit of my old Volcano candle. The old container had sat there on my desk…empty…cold…gently citrus scented and devoid of the sweet soft wax that glowed so gently from the jar. “WHY?!?!” I cried to the sky. “Why did it have to burn out so soon?!” I had fallen to the floor…collapsing in sadness and regret, knowing that my last precious moments with the old candle were spent watching Tennessee beat Alabama on the SEC network. I’d never forget that precious moment. The light flickered slowly and burned out as the Tennessee Volunteers carried the goal posts down to the Tennessee River. I sat there in my office…watching ESPN…editing audio for Halloween drops on the radio station where I work…melancholy…mourning the loss of my friend…the Capri Blue Volcano Candle. In my sadness…I turned to Amazon and ordered a replacement. So…there I was…opening my replacement candle. I slowly removed the box remnants…delicately pulled out my candle lighter…and gently lit the wick. Tears filled my eyes as I pondered my life choices…my meaning in the great vastness of the universe and the ease of ordering a candle…without stepping one foot inside of a brick and mortar store. This is truly what dreams are made of. Thank you…thank you…thank you. It’s all I’ve ever wanted. My only regret is that I could never repay the joy that this candle has given me. The end.

Product Summary: Capri Blue Volcano Scented and Luxury Glass Jar Candles for Home Scented with Tropical Fruit & Sugared Citrus - Soy Wax Blend, White Color (8 Oz)

About this Item

  • Capri Blue Petite Jar Candles - The instantly recognizable silhouette and bright white color of our glass jar candles makes them versatile enough for any home decor. Light and bright, these white candles are perfect for any space, any time of the year. All in all, a class act. This Capri Blue Volcano candle has a burn time of up to 40 hours.
  • Volcano Scented Candles - With its familiar feel and cult-like following, Capri Blue Volcano is the perfect blend of tropical fruits and sugared citrus. Like the excitement and energy of a summer night rendezvous, this fragrance is simply unforgettable.
  • Luxury Candles - Our soy wax blend has been fine tuned to give the ultimate fragrance experience. Our high-quality ingredients help to provide long lasting candles as well as provide a more fragrant experience.
  • Candle Care - Always allow the top of the candle wax to liquefy fully before blowing it out to help avoid tunneling. Keep the wick trimmed to ¼” & trim wick before the 1st burn. (Caution: Don’t drop debris into the wax. While burning, never place your decorative candles on uneven or sensitive surfaces or leave unattended.) Discontinue use when ½” wax remains to prevent damages to surfaces. Repurpose these glass candle jars in fun and exciting new ways!
  • About Us - Inspired by contemporary fashion trends, Capri Blue creates exciting new products for every season. Our Capri Blue blended soy wax candles are available in several beautifully colored candle jars. From small candles to large candles, these beauties are available in black, blue, white, aqua, and more - Buy them all! You can’t go wrong.

Product Description

Capri Blue has become the destination for unique fragrances and vibrant vessels. Pulling inspiration from fashion and home, we take striking visuals and twist them with complex fragrance to create a truly engaging combination for your senses. Capri Blue candles feature a single wick with a fragrant blend of soy and other natural grade waxes for a cleaner, longer burning candle. This candle uses eco-friendly practices with the highest quality materials. Immerse yourself in our unique flair and personality let us infuse your space with color and bring a touch of style to your day!
